mapper.sql: a.id, a.user_id, a.category_id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.status, a.allow_comment, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.create_time, a.update_time, CHAR_LENGTH(a.content) AS word_count, c.name AS category_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.blogger_name, ''), u.nickname) AS author_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.blogger_avatar, ''), u.avatar) AS author_avatar
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.category_id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.extra_content, a.extra_view_level, a.cover_image, a.status, a.allow_comment, a.view_count, a.like_count, CHAR_LENGTH(a.content) AS word_count, a.create_time, a.update_time, c.name AS category_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.blogger_name, ''), u.nickname) AS author_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.blogger_avatar, ''), u.avatar) AS author_avatar, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM article a2 WHERE a2.user_id = a.user_id AND a2.deleted = 0 AND a2.status = 2) AS author_article_count FROM article a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = a.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article (user_id, category_id, title, summary, content, extra_content, extra_view_level, cover_image, status, allow_comment, view_count, deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{extraContent}, #{extraViewLevel}, #{coverImage}, #{status}, #{allowComment}, #{viewCount}, #{deleted}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, content = #{content}, extra_content = #{extraContent}, extra_view_level = #{extraViewLevel}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, status = #{status}, allow_comment = #{allowComment}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE article SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM article WHERE deleted = 0
